summary: The first mismatch is caused by the missing whole uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_dise helper at the monster-to-monster AD_PEST path. mhitm_ad_pest copies Pestilence’s attack, changes it to AD_DISE, and calls the helper; the helper must zero damage against S_FUNGUS, Ghouls, and monsters defended against disease. JS currently records note_unported and keeps normal damage, so the Red Mold dies. The later corpse_chance RNG and missing Red Mold passive d(2,4) are downstream consequences, not passivemm defects.

source.branch: For a monster-pair hit, mhitm_ad_dise uses the monster defender’s data: S_FUNGUS, PM_GHOUL, or defended(mdef, AD_DISE) sets mhm.damage to zero; all other defenders take the attack’s normal damage. A hero attacker goes to this same branch. The separate monster-attacks-hero arm emits hitmsg and retains normal damage only when diseasemu succeeds; existing production dispatchers mdamagem and damageum do not pass a hero defender to this helper.
callers: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_pest: the monster-pair branch copies mattk, sets alt_attk.adtyp=AD_DISE, and calls mhitm_ad_dise.
uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping: the AD_DISE case directly calls mhitm_ad_dise; mdamagem dispatches monster-pair attacks through this switch, and damageum dispatches hero-to-monster attacks.
dependencies: uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_pest source caller branch must call the JS helper instead of note_unported.
uhitm.c:mhitm_adtyping AD_DISE switch arm must call the JS helper instead of unported.
Existing JS defended(..., AD_DISE) preserves the C monster-defense predicate.
Existing JS diseasemu() and hitmsg() implement the helper’s non-monster-pair source arm.

evidence: Current saved v47 queue entry: C and JS first disagree at zero-based step 138, screen index 138. C shows Pestilence touching the Red Mold and the monster remains alive; JS shows the tourist glyph at that map position after the target dies. At that action C next logs d(2,4)=2 in passivemm(mhitm.c:1326), while JS next logs rn2(3)=2 from corpse_chance after the Red Mold was killed. This places the causative difference before passivemm.

Upstream uhitm.c:4593-4619 defines the entire missing helper. Its monster-pair arm sets mhm.damage=0 for S_FUNGUS, PM_GHOUL, or defended(mdef, AD_DISE), and leaves ordinary damage unchanged otherwise.

Upstream uhitm.c:3808-3833 shows mhitm_ad_pest’s exact call: it copies mattk, changes adtyp to AD_DISE, then discards the void helper result. JS uhitm.js:mhitm_ad_pest currently substitutes note_unported in this monster-pair arm.

Upstream uhitm.c:4782-4825 contains the direct AD_DISE caller in mhitm_adtyping. JS uhitm.js currently stops that arm at unported("mhitm_ad_dise"). The complete source task must wire both existing callers.

The selected v47 recipe places a forced hostile Pestilence and hostile Red Mold under Conflict, then waits for the adjacent monster fight. The admitted queue identifies the exact caller and target state; its C/JS diff shows downstream corpse RNG only after JS omits the fungus damage guard.

Earlier v20 Pestilence-vs-hero cases exercise mhitu.c disease handling, not this monster-pair helper. The existing v21 Conflict cases and earlier uhitm recordings do not cover this Pestilence-against-fungus branch.
